purpose: Tenth unmapped quality-first reserve, adding conspiracy/hidden networks, ancient-alien/ancient-mystery source material, hidden history, dark journalism, and occult/metaphysical texts for later KFB deck/world/multiverse mapping.
sourcePolicy: Research reserve only. Preserve the distinction between what a source literally claims, what later interpreters infer, and what independent evidence establishes. Provenance and rights status are recorded now; no runtime eligibility or truth endorsement is implied.
mappingPolicy: UNMAPPED_BY_DESIGN. These clusters are intentionally relevant to existing KFB conspiracy, dark-journalism, secret-history, cosmic and metaphysical decks/worlds, but no deck/card/island/billboard/multiverse assignment is invented during collection.

rotationIntent.goal: Expand semantic and tonal diversity with a source/claim/interpretation tension pool suitable for later conspiratorial, ancient-mystery, hidden-history, dark-journalism and metaphysical contexts without collapsing them into one epistemic register.
rotationIntent.note: No runtime selector, world assignment, deck mapping, public approval or epistemic classification engine is changed in this research slice.
